answer_rule: Generation disabled pending this source-specific design blocker: edited_video_transcripts_need_fidelity_and_answer_span_review. No missing answers or labels are inferred.

USE all 10 shards. SKIP the 10 `*.jsonl.meta` files (18-byte record counts) and `README.md`.
eligible_records: This version emits zero examples; source-specific adapter/design review remains open.
ineligible_records: Malformed, incomplete, over-length (never truncated), privacy/secret patterns, unsupported or inconsistent labels, missing answer evidence, uncertain interpretation.

schema_documentation:
7 keys, flat, present in 100% of records across all 10 shards.

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100%, 0 empty | full video transcript — **primary training field** |
| `title` | str | 100% | video title (mean 73.9 ch, capped at ~101) |
| `id` | str | 100% | 11-char YouTube video id; 503 duplicates (0.32%) |
| `url` | str | 100% | `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`, always 43 ch |
| `channel` | str | 100% | 252 distinct channels |
| `category` | str | 100% | 17 distinct values (see notes) |
| `auto_generated` | bool | 100% | True 150,664 (97.0%) / False 4,590 (3.0%) |
semantic_meaning: 155,254 Greek YouTube video transcripts (news-dominated), punctuation-restored and disfluency-cleaned — 408M words, by far the largest source here.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized title; sentiment by complete normalized review; AMNA by validated article ID; Photodentro by validated learning-object ID. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
